Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]

jobs:
  build-preview:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'deploy-preview')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: ci-build-deploy-${{ github.ref }}
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          allow-unsafe-pr-checkout: true

      - name: Attempt merge with offline branch
        id: merge
        run: |

          git config user.name "deploy-ci"
          git config user.email "deploy-ci@users.noreply.github.com"
          git fetch origin offline-mode:offline-mode
          git checkout offline-mode

          if git merge --no-commit --no-ff ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}; then
            exit 0
          else
            git merge --abort
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Install Packages
        run: pnpm install --filter client --filter shared --filter server

      - name: Restore Atlas Cache
        id: cache-atlases-restore
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        if: always()
        with:
          path: ./client/node_modules/.atlas-cache/
          key: "atlas-cache-${{ github.run_id }}"
          restore-keys: |
            atlas-cache

      - name: Build Client
        run: pnpm run build
        working-directory: ./client

      - name: Save Atlas Cache
        id: cache-atlases-save
        uses: actions/cache/save@v5
        with:
          path: ./client/node_modules/.atlas-cache/
          key: "atlas-cache-${{ github.run_id }}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: build-dist
          path: ./client/dist

  deploy-preview:
    needs: build-preview
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: ci-deploy-${{ github.ref }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      deployments: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: build-dist
          path: ./client/dist/

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        id: deploy
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: ./client
          packageManager: pnpm
          command: pages deploy ./dist --project-name=survev-deploy-test --branch=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          gitHubToken: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v9
        with:
          script: |
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: `**Testing URL:** ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url }}
              hope it works 💃`
            });
